tools.name: get_brand_facts
tools.description: Every verified fact about Autoblogging.ai: company, founder, plans and prices, credit costs, features with the plan each needs, publishing integrations, policies and what not to state. Use this before describing Autoblogging.ai.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Autoblogging.ai plans (monthly and annual USD prices, credits per month, connected sites, free monthly allowances), billing policies and the credit cost of each tool.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: Autoblogging.ai features with a one-line summary, the cheapest plan that includes each one, its credit cost and its page URL. Optionally only the features available on a given plan.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search every page on autoblogging.ai (features, guides, comparisons, tutorials, knowledge base) by keywords. Returns titles, URLs, markdown URLs and descriptions; fetch a result with get_page.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Answer a plain-language question about Autoblogging.ai (pricing, plans, features, settings, integrations, comparisons) from its verified facts and its own pages; the same answer as fetching autoblogging.ai/{question-with-hyphens}. Returns markdown with the source page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The clean markdown text of any published page on autoblogging.ai (no navigation or scripts).
